evidence.why: EXPO_PUBLIC_ env vars are bundled into the client JS bundle, exposing the vendor payment provider API key in the shipped app.
Client directly calls the vendor payment API with the bundled secret key instead of routing through an authenticated backend that holds the key server-side.
Transaction/entitlement status is fetched and decided entirely on-device directly from the vendor API rather than via the project's own backend validating the record.

other_classes_observed: price/amount computed client-side and sent to payment API (potential tampering)
